pdf-merge.name: Merge PDF
pdf-merge.short: Combine several PDF files into one, in any order.
pdf-merge.title: Merge PDF — combine PDF files online, free
pdf-merge.description: Free online PDF merger. Combine several PDFs into a single file, reorder them first, and download instantly. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
pdf-merge.intro: Add the PDFs you want to combine, put them in the order you need, then merge. The files are read and combined inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server and there is no limit on how many times you can do it.

howTo.step1: Add two or more PDF files by dropping, choosing or pasting them.
howTo.step2: Drag the handle next to each file to put them in the order you want.
howTo.step3: Press Merge PDF and download the combined file.

faq.q1: Are my PDFs uploaded to a server?
faq.a1: No. The files are read into your browser's memory and combined there using JavaScript. Nothing is sent over the network, nothing is stored, and no one else can see the documents. This makes the tool safe for contracts, passports, medical records and anything else you would not want to upload.
faq.q2: Is there a limit on file size or number of files?
faq.a2: There is no artificial cap. The practical limit is your device's memory, since the whole document has to be held in RAM while it is built. Very large scanned files on an older phone are the case most likely to struggle; on a laptop, merging dozens of ordinary documents is fine.
faq.a3: No. Pages are copied across as-is, so text stays selectable, images keep their original resolution, and nothing is re-encoded. The merged file is normally close to the combined size of the originals.
faq.a4: Files that only carry an owner password will usually merge. A PDF encrypted with a user password — one that asks for a password before it will open at all — cannot be read without that password, so it cannot be merged here.
faq.q5: What happens to bookmarks and form fields?
faq.a5: Page content, text and images are preserved exactly. Document-level features such as bookmarks, form fields and attachments are not carried into the merged file. If you need those, keep the originals as well.

pdf-split.name: Split PDF
pdf-split.short: Extract selected pages into a new PDF.
pdf-split.title: Split PDF — extract pages online, free
pdf-split.description: Free online PDF splitter. Pick the pages you want by number or range and download them as a new PDF. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
pdf-split.intro: Add a PDF, type the pages you want to keep, and download them as a new file. Ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-10 work. The original is never changed and never leaves your device.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to split.
howTo.step2: Type the pages to keep, for example 1-3, 5, 8-10.
howTo.step3: Press Split PDF and download the result.

faq.q1: Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?
faq.a1: No. The document is read into your browser and the new file is built there. Nothing is transmitted or stored, so you can safely split private documents such as scanned identity papers or signed agreements.
faq.q2: How do I write the page ranges?
faq.a2: Separate entries with commas. A single number takes one page, and two numbers with a dash take everything between them inclusive. So 1-3, 5, 8-10 keeps pages 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 and 10. Pages that do not exist in the document are ignored rather than causing an error.
faq.q3: Does it change the original file?
faq.a3: No. The original is only read, never modified. The result is a new PDF containing copies of the pages you chose, and the file on your device stays exactly as it was.
faq.q4: Can I get each page as a separate file?
faq.a4: Not yet — this tool produces one new PDF from the pages you select. To get pages individually, run it once per page. A dedicated split-into-separate-files mode is planned.
faq.q5: Are the extracted pages lower quality?
faq.a5: No. Pages are copied without re-encoding, so text remains selectable and searchable and images keep their original resolution. The result is usually much smaller than the original simply because it has fewer pages.

pdf-rotate.name: Rotate PDF
pdf-rotate.short: Turn pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees and save the result.
pdf-rotate.title: Rotate PDF — turn pages online, free
pdf-rotate.description: Free online PDF rotator. Turn every page or just the ones you choose by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
pdf-rotate.intro: Add a PDF, pick how far to turn it, and optionally limit the change to particular pages. The rotation is written into the file itself, so it stays that way in every reader.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to rotate.
howTo.step2: Choose 90, 180 or 270 degrees, and optionally list the pages.
howTo.step3: Press Rotate PDF and download the result.

faq.q1: Is the rotation permanent?
faq.a1: Yes. The angle is stored in the document rather than applied by the viewer, so the pages open the right way up everywhere — including when printed. It is not a display-only setting that other readers might ignore.
faq.q2: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq.a2: Yes. Leave the page box empty to turn the whole document, or list pages and ranges like 2, 5-7 to change just those. Scanned documents where one page went in sideways are exactly the case this is for.
faq.q3: What if a page is already rotated?
faq.a3: The turn is added to whatever angle the page already had, rather than replacing it. So a page already at 90° rotated by another 90° ends up at 180°, which is what you would expect from pressing the button twice.
faq.a4: No. Only the page's rotation value changes — the text and images are untouched, so nothing is re-encoded and the file size stays roughly the same.

pdf-remove-pages.name: Remove PDF pages
pdf-remove-pages.short: Delete the pages you do not need and keep the rest.
pdf-remove-pages.title: Remove pages from PDF — delete pages online, free
pdf-remove-pages.description: Free online tool to delete pages from a PDF. List the pages to remove and download the rest as a new file. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
pdf-remove-pages.intro: Add a PDF and list the pages you want gone. Everything else is kept, in the original order, as a new file. The original on your device is never changed.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to trim.
howTo.step2: List the pages to remove, for example 2, 5-7.
howTo.step3: Press Remove pages and download the result.

faq.q1: What is the difference between this and Split PDF?
faq.a1: They are opposites. Split keeps the pages you list and discards the rest; this removes the pages you list and keeps the rest. Use whichever is less typing for the document in front of you.
faq.a2: No. A PDF with no pages is not a valid document, so at least one page has to stay. If you try to select all of them the button is disabled and the tool tells you why, rather than handing you a file that some readers refuse to open.
faq.a3: No. The original is only read. The result is a new PDF containing copies of the pages you kept, and the file on your device stays exactly as it was.
faq.a4: No. Pages are copied across as-is, so text stays selectable and searchable and images keep their resolution. The new file is smaller only because it has fewer pages.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.short: Turn JPG photos into a single PDF, in any order.
jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF — convert JPG images to PDF online, free
jpg-to-pdf.description: Free online JPG to PDF converter. Combine JPG photos into one PDF, reorder them and choose A4 or original size. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
jpg-to-pdf.intro: Add your JPG files, drag them into the order you want, and create a PDF. This is the quickest way to turn photos of a document — a passport, a contract, a receipt — into something you can email or print as one file.

howTo.step1: Add your JPG images by dropping, choosing or pasting them.
howTo.step2: Drag them into the right order and pick A4 or original size.
howTo.step3: Press Create PDF and download the file.

faq.q1: Are my photos uploaded anywhere?
faq.a1: No. The images are read into your browser and the PDF is built there. Nothing is sent over the network, which matters when the photos are of identity documents or signed paperwork.
faq.q2: Should I choose A4 or original size?
faq.a2: Choose A4 if the PDF will be printed or sent somewhere official — every page comes out the same standard size with the image centred. Choose original size to keep the exact pixel dimensions, which suits screenshots and images meant only for screens.
faq.a3: Only if you choose to. “Original quality” embeds the JPG data exactly as it is — no second round of compression, and a PDF roughly the combined size of the originals, which for phone photos means several megabytes per page. “Smaller file” (the default) resizes photos to 2000 px on the long side and re-encodes them at high quality: usually a fifth of the size, and still sharp for reading and printing.
faq.q4: How many photos can I add?
faq.a4: There is no fixed limit. Every image is held in memory while the PDF is assembled, so the practical ceiling is your device — dozens of phone photos are fine on a laptop, and fewer on an older phone.
faq.q5: The file is named .jpg but will not convert. Why?
faq.a5: The format is detected from the file's actual contents rather than its name, because files renamed to .jpg are often something else entirely. If it is really a PNG, use the PNG to PDF tool instead.

png-to-pdf.name: PNG to PDF
png-to-pdf.short: Turn PNG images into a single PDF, in any order.
png-to-pdf.title: PNG to PDF — convert PNG images to PDF online, free
png-to-pdf.description: Free online PNG to PDF converter. Combine PNG images into one PDF, reorder them and choose A4 or original size. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
png-to-pdf.intro: Add your PNG files, put them in order, and create a PDF. Transparency is flattened onto a white background, which is what you want for anything that will be printed or shared as a document.

howTo.step1: Add your PNG images by dropping, choosing or pasting them.
howTo.step2: Drag them into the right order and pick A4 or original size.
howTo.step3: Press Create PDF and download the file.

faq.q1: Are my images uploaded anywhere?
faq.a1: No. The images are read into your browser and the PDF is built there. Nothing is transmitted or stored, so screenshots of private dashboards or documents stay private.
faq.a2: PDF pages are not transparent, so any transparent areas end up showing the page behind them as white. If transparency matters to the final look, flatten the image onto the background you want before converting.
faq.a3: No. PNG is lossless and is embedded as-is, so screenshots and diagrams stay pixel-perfect and text in them stays sharp. The one exception is “Smaller file” with a very large PNG: it is scaled down to 2000 px but stays PNG — never turned into a JPEG.
faq.q4: Why is my PDF larger than the PNGs?
faq.a4: PNG is efficient for flat graphics but the PDF wrapper adds structure around each image, and nothing is re-compressed to make up for it. For screenshot-heavy documents that is a fair trade for keeping the images exact.

pdf-header-footer.name: Add header and footer to PDF
pdf-header-footer.short: Put the same text at the top or bottom of every page.
pdf-header-footer.title: Add Header and Footer to PDF — free online tool
pdf-header-footer.description: Free online tool to add a header and footer to a PDF. Set the text, alignment and size, applied to every page. Runs in your browser.
pdf-header-footer.intro: Add a PDF and type the text you want at the top, the bottom, or both. It is applied to every page at the alignment and size you choose.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to label.
howTo.step2: Type header and footer text, and set alignment and size.
howTo.step3: Press Add header and footer, then download.

faq.q1: Can I set only one of them?
faq.a1: Yes. Leave either box empty and only the other is drawn, so this works equally well as a header-only or footer-only tool.
faq.q2: Will the text overlap my content?
faq.a2: It sits about 28 points from the page edge, which clears the margin on ordinary documents. A PDF laid out edge to edge could overlap, so check before sharing.
faq.a3: The fonts built into the PDF format only cover Latin characters. Drawing Cyrillic would mean embedding a font file, which is a large download for every visitor. The tool says so rather than producing empty boxes.
faq.a4: Not here — the same text goes on every page. Use the page numbers tool for that, and run both if you want numbering and a label.

pdf-resize.name: Resize PDF pages
pdf-resize.short: Convert to A4, Letter or Legal, or scale by percentage.
pdf-resize.title: Resize PDF — change page size to A4 or Letter online, free
pdf-resize.description: Free online PDF page resizer. Convert pages to A4, Letter or Legal, or scale them by percentage, with content centred and never stretched.
pdf-resize.intro: Add a PDF and choose a target page size. Content is scaled proportionally and centred, so nothing is distorted or cut off. Useful when a document arrives in Letter and the printer expects A4.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to resize.
howTo.step2: Choose A4, Letter, Legal, or a percentage.
howTo.step3: Press Resize PDF and download the result.

faq.q1: Will my content get stretched?
faq.a1: No. The scale factor is the smaller of the two dimensions' ratios, so the aspect ratio is kept and the page is padded rather than distorted. The scaled content is then centred, which is the part tools that only change the page box get wrong.
faq.a2: They stay landscape. The target size is rotated to match each page's own orientation, so a mixed portrait-and-landscape document does not come back all upright.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Letter and A4?
faq.a3: A4 is 210 × 297 mm, standard almost everywhere. Letter is 216 × 279 mm, used in the US and Canada — slightly wider and shorter. Printing one on the other leaves uneven margins, which is what this fixes.
faq.a4: No. PDF content is vector where the original was vector, so scaling stays sharp at any size. Embedded images are scaled by the viewer at display time, exactly as before.

pdf-flatten.name: Flatten PDF
pdf-flatten.short: Turn form fields into fixed page content.
pdf-flatten.title: Flatten PDF — make form fields uneditable online, free
pdf-flatten.description: Free online tool to flatten a PDF. Converts filled form fields into fixed page content so the values can no longer be changed. Runs in your browser.
pdf-flatten.intro: Add a PDF with form fields and flatten it. The values become ordinary page content that looks identical but can no longer be edited or accidentally cleared.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to flatten.
howTo.step2: Check how many form fields were found.
howTo.step3: Press Flatten PDF and download the result.

faq.q1: Why flatten a form?
faq.a1: A filled form still holds editable fields, so anyone can change the values, and some viewers show empty boxes or lose the contents on save. Flattening fixes the values in place, which is what you want before emailing a completed form.
faq.a2: No. The fields are gone once flattened — that is the point. Keep the fillable original if you may need to change the answers later.
faq.a3: It should look the same. The values are drawn onto the page where the fields were. Interactive highlighting disappears, since there is nothing left to interact with.
faq.q4: What if my PDF has no form?
faq.a4: You get a valid copy back with nothing changed. The tool says so up front rather than implying it did something.

pdf-fill-form.name: Fill PDF form
pdf-fill-form.short: Fill in a PDF's form fields in your browser.
pdf-fill-form.title: Fill PDF Form — complete a fillable PDF online, free
pdf-fill-form.description: Free online PDF form filler. Read a PDF's fields, fill them in and optionally flatten so the values cannot be edited. Nothing is uploaded.
pdf-fill-form.intro: Add a fillable PDF and every field it contains appears as an ordinary form. Fill them in, optionally flatten, and download. Nothing is uploaded, which matters for applications and contracts.

howTo.step1: Add a PDF that has fillable fields.
howTo.step2: Fill in the fields shown.
howTo.step3: Press Fill form and download the completed PDF.

faq.q1: Why does it say there are no fields?
faq.a1: Because the PDF has no interactive form. Many documents only look fillable — a scan with printed lines has no fields at all. For those, use the signature tool to place text or a signature on the page instead.
faq.a2: Text boxes, checkboxes, dropdowns and radio groups. Signature and button fields are listed but cannot be filled here; use the signature tool for those.
faq.a3: Flatten if you are sending the finished form to someone. It stops the values being changed and avoids viewers that render fields inconsistently. Leave it unflattened if you may need to edit later.
faq.a4: No. The document is parsed and rewritten in your browser, so passport numbers and bank details on an application form never leave your device.

pdf-sign.title: Sign PDF — draw and add a signature online, free
pdf-sign.description: Free online PDF signing tool. Draw your signature with a finger, stylus or mouse and place it anywhere on any page. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q1: Is this a legally binding digital signature?
faq.a1: No, and it is worth being precise. This places a picture of your signature on the page — the same standing as a scanned signature, which many organisations accept. It is not a cryptographic signature, so it does not prove who signed or reveal later changes. Where the law requires a qualified electronic signature, use an accredited provider.
faq.q2: Can I sign on my phone?
faq.a2: Yes, and it works better than a mouse. The drawing area accepts finger and stylus input directly, and the canvas is drawn at your screen's real resolution so the signature stays sharp.
faq.q3: How do I position it accurately?
faq.a3: The sliders set position as a percentage of the page, so the placement holds whatever the page size. Start around 60% from the left and 80% from the top for a typical signature line, then adjust and re-run if needed.
faq.a4: No. It exists only in the page while the tab is open, and is embedded into the PDF on your device. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is remembered between visits.

pdf-protect.name: Protect PDF with a password
pdf-protect.short: Add a password so the PDF cannot be opened without it.
pdf-protect.title: Protect PDF — add a password online, free
pdf-protect.description: Free online tool to password-protect a PDF. Encryption happens in your browser, so neither the file nor the password is ever uploaded.
pdf-protect.intro: Add a PDF and choose a password. The file is encrypted inside your browser and cannot be opened without that password. Neither the document nor the password is sent anywhere.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to protect.
howTo.step2: Choose a password and type it twice.
howTo.step3: Press Protect PDF and download the encrypted file.

faq.q1: Is my password sent to a server?
faq.a1: No, and this is the whole point. Encryption runs in your browser, so the password exists only on your device. Online tools that do this server-side necessarily receive both your document and your password — which is a strange trade for a file you are trying to keep private.
faq.a2: No. The document is genuinely encrypted, so there is no reset and no back door. If you forget the password the file is unreadable. Store it somewhere before you close the tab.
faq.a3: It uses the PDF standard's own encryption, which every reader understands. Its real strength depends on your password — a short or common one can be attacked offline. Use something long, and consider the password generator on this site.
faq.q4: Will it open in any PDF reader?
faq.a4: Yes. It is standard PDF encryption, so Acrobat, browsers, phones and printers all prompt for the password normally.

pdf-unlock.name: Unlock PDF
pdf-unlock.short: Remove a password from a PDF you can already open.
pdf-unlock.title: Unlock PDF — remove a PDF password online, free
pdf-unlock.description: Free online tool to remove a password from a PDF. Enter the password you already have and download an unlocked copy. Runs in your browser.
pdf-unlock.intro: Add a protected PDF and enter its password to get an unlocked copy. Useful when a bank statement or payslip arrives encrypted and you are tired of typing the password every time you open it.

howTo.step1: Add the password-protected PDF.
howTo.step2: Enter the password. Leave it empty if the file opens without one.
howTo.step3: Press Remove password and download the unlocked copy.

faq.q1: Do I need to know the password?
faq.a1: Yes, if the file requires one to open. This tool removes protection from documents you can already access — it does not break or guess passwords, and it will not help with a file you have been locked out of.
faq.q2: Why does it work with an empty password?
faq.a2: Some PDFs carry only an owner password, which restricts printing or editing but lets anyone open the file. Those decrypt with an empty password, which is why the field can be left blank. Statements and payslips more often use a real user password.
faq.a3: No. The file on your device is only read. You get a new, unencrypted copy, and the protected original stays as it was.
faq.a4: Pages, text and images are copied across exactly. Removing encryption requires rebuilding the document, so some document-level extras such as bookmarks, form fields and attachments are not carried over. Title, author and subject are preserved.

pdf-page-numbers.name: Add page numbers to PDF

pdf-page-numbers.intro: Add a PDF, choose where the numbers go and what to start at, and download the numbered file. Useful for contracts, reports and anything that has to be referenced by page.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to number.
howTo.step2: Pick a position, a starting number and a text size.

faq.q1: Can I skip the cover page?
faq.a1: Yes. Tick 'Skip the first page' and numbering starts on page two. The count still advances, so page two shows the second number — which is what a report with an unnumbered cover normally wants.
faq.q2: Can numbering start at something other than 1?
faq.a2: Yes. Set any starting number, which is what you need when the PDF is one section of a longer document and its first page is really page 47.

pdf-watermark.name: Watermark PDF
pdf-watermark.short: Stamp text across every page of a PDF.
pdf-watermark.title: Watermark PDF — add a text watermark online, free
pdf-watermark.description: Free online PDF watermark tool. Stamp DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL or your own text across every page, with adjustable size, angle and opacity. Runs in your browser.
pdf-watermark.intro: Add a PDF, type the text you want stamped across it, and adjust the size, angle and opacity until it reads clearly without hiding the content underneath.

howTo.step2: Type the text and adjust size, opacity and angle.
howTo.step3: Press Add watermark and download the result.

faq.q1: Why will it not accept Cyrillic text?
faq.a1: The fonts built into the PDF format only cover Latin characters. Drawing Cyrillic means embedding a font file, which would add a large download to every visit for a feature most people do not need. The tool tells you rather than producing a file full of blank boxes.
faq.a2: It is drawn into the page content, so it will not come off by toggling a setting. It is not security, though — anyone determined enough can edit it out. Treat it as a clear label, not protection.
faq.a3: Around 20-30% is usually right: clearly visible, but the text underneath stays readable. Go higher only when the watermark matters more than the content, such as a sample document you do not want used.
faq.q4: Does it go on every page?
faq.a4: Yes, every page gets the same watermark, centred and rotated by the angle you choose. Per-page watermarks are not supported.

pdf-info.name: PDF info
pdf-info.short: See page count, size, author and other PDF details.
pdf-info.title: PDF Info — view PDF metadata and page sizes online, free
pdf-info.description: Free online PDF inspector. See page count, file size, page dimensions, title, author and dates without opening an editor. Runs in your browser.
pdf-info.intro: Add a PDF to see what is actually inside it: how many pages, what size they are, which software produced it, and what metadata is attached. Nothing is uploaded, so it is safe to inspect confidential files.

howTo.step1: Add the PDF you want to inspect.
howTo.step2: Read the details, including page sizes.

faq.q1: Why does the page size matter?
faq.a1: Printers and upload forms often require a specific size. This shows both the familiar name — A4, Letter — and the exact point dimensions, so you can tell whether a document that 'looks A4' really is. Mixed sizes in one file are shown separately.
faq.q2: What is the difference between creator and producer?
faq.a2: Creator is the program the document was originally written in, such as Word. Producer is what converted it to PDF. Together they often reveal how a file was made, which is useful when a PDF behaves oddly.
faq.a3: PDF metadata is optional, and many generators leave it blank. An empty title or author means nothing was set, not that anything is wrong with the file.
faq.a4: The file carries a password or permission restrictions. Details can still usually be read, but editing tools may refuse to modify it. Files with a user password cannot be opened at all without it.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage calculator
percentage-calculator.short: Percentages, discounts, changes and VAT in one place.

howTo.step3: Read the result, which updates as you type.

faq.q1: What is the difference between inclusive and exclusive VAT?
faq.a1: Exclusive means the price does not yet contain the tax, so VAT is added on top. Inclusive means the price already contains it, so the tax is extracted from within. Prices in Uzbekistan and most of Europe are quoted inclusive, and getting this backwards is the most common mistake in VAT sums.
faq.q2: How do I take VAT out of a price?
faq.a2: Tick 'Amount already includes VAT'. Dividing by 1.12 for a 12% rate is correct; subtracting 12% is not, and gives a number that is too low. The tool does the division for you.
faq.q3: Why is a 50% rise then a 50% fall not back where you started?
faq.a3: Because each percentage applies to a different base. 100 rises by 50% to 150; 50% of 150 is 75, so falling by 50% lands on 75, not 100. Use the '% change' mode to see the real change between two figures.
faq.q4: Is the discount before or after tax?
faq.a4: The discount mode works on whatever figure you enter, so it depends on which price you type in. For an inclusive price, the result is also inclusive.

age-calculator.name: Age calculator
age-calculator.short: Exact age or the difference between any two dates.
age-calculator.title: Age Calculator — exact age and date difference, free
age-calculator.description: Free online age calculator. Get exact years, months and days between two dates, plus totals in months, weeks and days. Runs in your browser.
age-calculator.intro: Enter a date of birth and a date to measure to. You get the exact difference in years, months and days, plus the totals — and how long until the next anniversary.

howTo.step1: Enter the date of birth, or any start date.

howTo.step3: Read the exact difference and the totals.

faq.q1: How are months counted?
faq.a1: By the calendar, not a flat 30 days. From 31 January, one month lands on 28 February, because February has no 31st. That matches how people talk about months and how date libraries behave.
faq.q2: What about someone born on 29 February?
faq.a2: In a common year they age on 28 February. That follows from the same clamping rule and matches how most jurisdictions treat leap-day birthdays, though a few use 1 March.
faq.a3: Yes. The order does not matter — the difference is always reported as a positive amount, so you can use it as a countdown as easily as an age.
faq.q4: Why do total months and years plus months differ?
faq.a4: They do not: total months is the same figure expressed differently. 3 years and 5 months is 41 total months. Days beyond that are shown separately rather than rounded into it.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI calculator

faq.q1: What do the categories mean?
faq.a1: Below 18.5 is underweight, 18.5 to 24.9 normal, 25 to 29.9 overweight, and 30 or above obese. These are the World Health Organization bands used for adults.
faq.a2: It is a screening figure, not a diagnosis. It uses only height and weight, so it cannot tell muscle from fat — a muscular athlete can register as overweight while carrying very little. Treat an unexpected result as a reason to ask a doctor, not a conclusion.
faq.a3: No. Children and teenagers are assessed against age and sex percentile charts, not these fixed bands. The same applies during pregnancy.
faq.q4: Why does the healthy range look wide?
faq.a4: Because BMI scales with the square of height, so the normal band covers a real spread of weights — roughly 20 kg at 175 cm. Where you sit within it depends on build.

loan-calculator.name: Loan calculator

howTo.step3: Read the monthly payment and the total interest.

faq.q1: Which kind of loan does this model?
faq.a1: An annuity loan, where every payment is the same and the split between interest and principal shifts over time. That covers most mortgages, car loans and consumer credit. Loans with a fixed principal repayment plus interest work differently and start higher.
faq.q2: Is the rate monthly or annual?
faq.a2: Annual. It is divided by twelve internally. Entering a monthly rate by mistake produces a payment roughly twelve times too high, which is the usual sign something is wrong.
faq.q3: Why is the total interest so large?
faq.a3: Because interest is charged on the outstanding balance for the whole term. Over a long term it compounds into a large share of the total — the bar shows exactly what proportion. Shortening the term usually saves far more than a small rate reduction.
faq.q4: Does it include fees and insurance?
faq.a4: No. Arrangement fees, insurance and other charges are not modelled, so a lender's stated total cost will normally be higher than this figure.

faq.a1: The Central Bank of Uzbekistan, which publishes official rates once a working day. If that source is unreachable the converter falls back to exchangerate-api.com. The source and date are always shown under the result, so you know exactly what you are looking at.

faq.q1: Why is temperature handled differently?
faq.a1: Because its scales have different zero points, so you cannot just multiply by a factor. Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit needs both a multiplication and an offset — which is why 0 °C is 32 °F rather than 0 °F.
faq.a2: The factors are exact by definition where one exists — an inch is exactly 25.4 mm and a pound exactly 0.45359237 kg. Results are rounded for display only.
faq.a3: US. A US gallon is about 3.785 litres and an imperial gallon about 4.546, so they are not interchangeable — a recipe using imperial measures will come out roughly 20% short.
faq.a4: One nautical mile per hour, about 1.852 km/h. It is used in aviation and shipping because a nautical mile corresponds to one minute of latitude.

faq.q1: Is daylight saving handled?
faq.a1: Yes. Conversions use your browser's own time zone database, so each zone's offset is computed for the specific date you chose. Tools that store fixed offsets go wrong twice a year, and are wrong for a fortnight when regions change dates.
faq.q2: Why does the offset change with the date?
faq.a2: Because many zones shift by an hour seasonally. London is UTC+0 in winter and UTC+1 in summer, so the gap to a non-shifting zone such as Tashkent changes depending on the month.
faq.a3: No. Tashkent stays on UTC+5 all year, which means the difference to Europe changes twice a year even though nothing changes locally — the usual source of confusion when scheduling with European colleagues.
faq.q4: Why show the offset next to each zone?
faq.a4: So you can sanity-check the result. If a converted time looks wrong, the offset usually explains it — most often because one of the zones has just entered or left daylight saving.

faq.a2: Slightly, because JPEG is lossy and the image is encoded a second time. At the quality used here the difference is hard to see on photographs. For screenshots and flat graphics, PNG to PDF gives a cleaner result.

faq.q1: Why will nothing open my HEIC files?
faq.a1: HEIC is Apple's default photo format. Safari can display it, but most other browsers, Windows without an add-on, and many upload forms cannot. Converting to PDF sidesteps that entirely, since PDF opens everywhere.

faq.a2: No. HEIC decoding runs in your browser using a WebAssembly decoder loaded only when a HEIC file is added. Photographs of passports and contracts never leave your device, which is exactly why this matters.
faq.q3: Why is it slower than JPG to PDF?
faq.a3: HEIC has to be decoded before anything else can happen, and no browser except Safari can do it natively. The decoder is a few hundred kilobytes and each photo takes a moment. Large batches on an older phone will feel slow.
faq.a4: There is one re-encode, from HEIC to JPEG at high quality, because PDF cannot store HEIC. For documents and receipts the difference is invisible.

image-to-pdf.intro: Add images in whatever format your phone or computer produces — JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC from an iPhone, even GIF — drag them into order, and create one PDF. Formats can be mixed freely; each image becomes one page.

faq.q1: Which image formats are accepted?
faq.a1: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and Apple's HEIC/HEIF, in any mix. The format is read from each file's actual contents, so a renamed file is handled correctly. JPG and PNG are embedded as they are; WebP, GIF and HEIC are converted to JPEG first, because the PDF format cannot hold them directly.
faq.a2: No. Everything happens inside your browser and nothing is sent over the network — which is what makes this safe for passports, contracts and medical papers.

faq.a3: Choose A4 if the PDF will be printed or sent somewhere official — every page comes out the same standard size with the image centred. Choose original size to keep the exact pixel dimensions, which suits screenshots and images meant only for screens.
faq.a4: With “Original quality”, JPG and PNG are embedded without re-encoding; HEIC, WebP and GIF become high-quality JPEGs, an unavoidable and usually invisible loss. “Smaller file” (the default) also resizes photos to 2000 px and re-encodes them at high quality — a fraction of the size, still sharp to print. PNGs are only ever downscaled, never turned into JPEG.
faq.q5: Can I mix photos and screenshots?
faq.a5: Yes. Each image becomes one page. With A4 selected every page is the same size with the image centred; with original size each page takes the dimensions of its own image.

faq.a3: PNG is lossless, so the quality slider does nothing for it — that is why it is disabled. To shrink a PNG photograph meaningfully, convert it to JPEG or WebP. PNG is the right choice only for screenshots, logos and images with sharp edges or transparency.
faq.a4: No. Compression uses your browser's own image encoder, so nothing is transmitted. That also means speed depends on your device rather than on someone else's queue.

png-to-jpg.short: Convert PNG images to JPG, usually much smaller.
png-to-jpg.title: PNG to JPG — convert PNG images online, free
png-to-jpg.description: Free online PNG to JPG converter with a quality slider. Photographs saved as PNG usually shrink dramatically. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
png-to-jpg.intro: Add a PNG and download it as a JPG. This is worth doing when a photograph has been saved as PNG — the file is often several times larger than it needs to be, with no visible benefit.

howTo.step1: Add your PNG image.
howTo.step2: Choose a quality level.
howTo.step3: Press Convert to JPEG and download the result.

faq.q1: How much smaller will it be?
faq.a1: For photographs, often five to ten times smaller. PNG stores every pixel exactly, which suits flat graphics but is wasteful for photographic detail that JPEG can approximate almost invisibly.
faq.a2: JPEG has no alpha channel, so transparent areas are filled with white rather than turning black — which is what happens in tools that skip this step. If you need transparency, keep the PNG.
faq.a3: No. JPEG discards information permanently, so converting back to PNG restores the format but not the lost detail. Keep the original PNG if you may need to edit it later.
faq.a4: Keep PNG for screenshots, logos, diagrams and anything with sharp edges or text. JPEG blurs hard edges into visible artefacts, which is most obvious on screenshots of text.

jpg-to-png.name: JPG to PNG
jpg-to-png.short: Convert JPG images to lossless PNG.
jpg-to-png.title: JPG to PNG — convert JPG images online, free
jpg-to-png.description: Free online JPG to PNG converter. Produce a lossless PNG that survives further editing without extra compression. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
jpg-to-png.intro: Add a JPG and download it as a PNG. Useful when a tool or upload form insists on PNG, or when you are about to edit an image and want no further compression applied on each save.

howTo.step1: Add your JPG image.
howTo.step2: Press Convert to PNG.
howTo.step3: Download the result.

faq.q1: Does converting improve quality?
faq.a1: No, and this is worth being clear about. Whatever JPEG discarded is already gone — PNG simply stops any further loss. It preserves what is there rather than restoring what was lost.
faq.q2: Why is the PNG so much bigger?
faq.a2: PNG is lossless, so it stores every pixel exactly, including the compression artefacts JPEG introduced. A photograph converted to PNG is commonly several times larger than the JPEG it came from.
faq.a3: When something requires PNG, or when you are about to edit and re-save repeatedly — each JPEG save compounds the loss, while PNG saves do not. It is also useful before adding transparency.
faq.a4: The format supports it, but the image will not gain any: a JPEG has no transparency to carry over, so the result is fully opaque. You would need an editor to remove a background.

webp-to-jpg.name: WebP to JPG
webp-to-jpg.short: Convert WebP images to widely supported JPG.
webp-to-jpg.title: WebP to JPG — convert WebP images online, free
webp-to-jpg.description: Free online WebP to JPG converter. Turn WebP files into JPG that any program will open. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
webp-to-jpg.intro: Add a WebP file and download it as a JPG. WebP is what most sites now serve, which means images saved from the web often will not open in older software or upload forms.

howTo.step1: Add your WebP image.
howTo.step2: Choose a quality level.
howTo.step3: Press Convert to JPEG and download the result.

faq.q1: Why will nothing open my WebP file?
faq.a1: WebP is well supported in browsers but much less so elsewhere — older versions of Windows Photo Viewer, some office software and many upload forms still reject it. JPEG is accepted essentially everywhere.
faq.a2: There is one re-encode from WebP to JPEG, so a small amount is lost. At high quality it is not visible on photographs. The bigger practical change is that the file usually gets larger, since JPEG is less efficient.
faq.a3: JPEG has no alpha channel, so transparent areas become white. If transparency matters, convert to PNG instead.
faq.a4: No. Only the first frame is converted, because JPEG cannot hold animation. For animated files you would need a GIF or video converter instead.

heic-to-jpg.name: HEIC to JPG
heic-to-jpg.short: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG.
heic-to-jpg.title: HEIC to JPG — convert iPhone photos online, free
heic-to-jpg.description: Free online HEIC to JPG converter. Turn iPhone photos into JPG that opens anywhere, without installing anything. Runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
heic-to-jpg.intro: Add a HEIC photo from your iPhone and download it as a JPG. Decoding happens in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device — which matters when it is a picture of a document.

howTo.step1: Add your HEIC photo.
howTo.step2: Choose a quality level.
howTo.step3: Press Convert to JPEG and download the result.

faq.q1: Why are my iPhone photos HEIC?
faq.a1: It is Apple's default since iOS 11, chosen because it stores similar quality in roughly half the space of JPEG. The cost is compatibility: outside Apple's own software, support is patchy. Setting Camera to 'Most Compatible' makes the phone shoot JPEG instead.
faq.q2: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: No. A WebAssembly decoder runs in your browser, loaded only when a HEIC file is added. Most HEIC converters online upload the file; this one does not, which matters for photos of identity documents.
faq.q3: Why does it take a few seconds?
faq.a3: HEIC uses HEVC compression, which is heavy to decode, and only Safari can do it natively. Everywhere else the decoder has to be downloaded and run in software. Expect roughly a second or two per photo.
faq.a4: There is one re-encode to JPEG. At the default quality the difference is not visible for normal photographs, though the JPEG will typically be larger than the HEIC it came from.

qr-generator.name: QR code generator
qr-generator.short: Create a QR code from any link or text, ready to download.
qr-generator.title: QR Code Generator — create free QR codes online
qr-generator.description: Free online QR code generator. Turn any link or text into a downloadable PNG QR code, with adjustable size and error correction. Runs in your browser.
qr-generator.intro: Type a link or any text and the QR code appears as you type. Download it as a PNG to print on a menu, a poster or a business card. The codes never expire and do not pass through any tracking redirect.

howTo.step1: Type or paste your link or text.
howTo.step2: Adjust the size and error correction if you need to.
howTo.step3: Download the PNG.

faq.q1: Do these codes expire?
faq.a1: No. The QR code encodes your link directly, so it works for as long as that link does. Beware of generators offering 'dynamic' codes — those point at the generator's own redirect, which can stop working or start charging.
faq.a2: It adds redundancy so the code still scans when part of it is damaged, dirty or covered. L tolerates about 7% damage and H about 30%. Higher levels make the pattern denser, so for a fixed print size the modules get smaller.
faq.a3: M is a good default for screens and clean printing. Choose H if the code will be printed small, placed outdoors, or have a logo overlaid on the middle — that overlay is damage as far as the scanner is concerned.
faq.q4: Why does it say there is too much data?
faq.a4: QR codes have a capacity limit that falls as error correction rises. Long URLs with tracking parameters hit it surprisingly often. Shorten the link or lower the level.
faq.a5: No. The code is generated in your browser, so the link — which might be a private document or an internal address — is never transmitted or logged.

youtube-thumbnail.name: YouTube thumbnail downloader
youtube-thumbnail.short: Get the thumbnail image from any YouTube video.

howTo.step2: Pick the size you want.

faq.q1: Why is the 1280 × 720 version missing?
faq.a1: YouTube only generates the maximum-resolution thumbnail when the uploaded video was large enough, so older and lower-resolution videos simply do not have one. When it fails to load, the next size down always exists.
faq.a2: Standard watch links, youtu.be short links, Shorts, embed and live URLs, and a bare 11-character video ID. The ID is extracted locally — the link is never sent anywhere.
faq.q3: Can I use these images freely?
faq.a3: Not automatically. Thumbnails are usually the uploader's copyrighted work. Referencing a video, commentary and reviews are commonly acceptable; republishing as your own or using them commercially generally is not.
faq.q4: Does it work for private videos?
faq.a4: No. Thumbnails are served from a public URL only for public and unlisted videos. Private videos have no publicly reachable image, so nothing will load.

color-picker.name: Colour picker
color-picker.short: Convert between HEX, RGB and HSL, with contrast checking.
color-picker.title: Colour Picker — HEX to RGB and HSL converter, free
color-picker.description: Free online colour picker and converter. Move between HEX, RGB and HSL and check WCAG contrast against white and black. Runs in your browser.
color-picker.intro: Pick a colour or type a HEX value and get it in every common notation, along with its contrast against white and black. The contrast figures are the ones accessibility guidelines actually use.

howTo.step1: Pick a colour, or type a HEX value like #0369a1.
howTo.step2: Copy whichever notation you need.
howTo.step3: Check the contrast figures before using it for text.

faq.q1: What do the contrast numbers mean?
faq.a1: They are the ratio between your colour's brightness and white or black, as defined by WCAG. Body text needs at least 4.5:1 against its background, and large or bold text at least 3:1. Below that, the text is hard to read for many people and fails accessibility audits.
faq.q2: Why not just compare RGB values?
faq.a2: Because the eye is far more sensitive to green than to blue. The calculation weights the channels accordingly and linearises them first, which is why two colours with similar RGB numbers can have very different contrast.
faq.q3: When is HSL more useful than HEX?
faq.a3: When building a palette. HSL separates hue from saturation and lightness, so you can produce a lighter or more muted version of a colour by changing one number, instead of guessing at a new HEX value.
faq.q4: Does it accept short HEX codes?
faq.a4: Yes. Three-digit values like #0af are expanded automatically, with or without the leading hash.

password-generator.name: Password generator
password-generator.short: Create strong random passwords that never leave your device.
password-generator.title: Password Generator — strong random passwords, free
password-generator.description: Free online password generator. Creates strong random passwords in your browser using the Web Crypto API. Nothing is sent to a server, logged or stored.
password-generator.intro: Set the length and which character types to use, and a new password is generated instantly. It is produced by your browser's cryptographic random number generator and never transmitted anywhere, so it is safe to use for real accounts.

howTo.step1: Choose a length with the slider.
howTo.step2: Pick which character types to include.
howTo.step3: Copy the password, or press Generate again for a different one.

faq.q1: Is the password sent to a server?
faq.a1: No. It is generated inside your browser and never leaves your device — not to us, not to anyone. That is the difference between this and a password generator that runs on a server, where the password necessarily travels across the network.
faq.a2: Yes. It uses crypto.getRandomValues, the browser's cryptographically secure generator, not Math.random — which is predictable and unsuitable for passwords. Values that would skew the result are discarded rather than folded in, so every character is equally likely.
faq.q3: What does the entropy figure mean?
faq.a3: It is how many bits of randomness the password contains, which is the honest measure of how hard it is to guess. Each extra bit doubles the work an attacker faces. Under 50 bits is weak, 80 or more is strong for most accounts, and 120 or more is excellent.
faq.a4: Only if you will be typing or reading the password out — it removes I, l, 1, O and 0, which are easy to confuse. It slightly reduces the character set, so add a few characters of length to compensate.
faq.q5: Is longer better than more symbols?
faq.a5: Usually, yes. Adding length raises entropy faster than adding character types, and long passwords are easier to store in a password manager. A 20-character password using only letters is stronger than a 10-character one using everything.

howTo.step2: Paste your text or Base64 into the input box.
howTo.step3: Copy the result, or press Swap to run it back the other way.

faq.q1: Does it handle Cyrillic and Uzbek text?
faq.a1: Yes. The text is converted to UTF-8 bytes before encoding, so any alphabet round-trips correctly. Many simple tools call btoa directly, which only understands Latin-1 and either throws an error or silently mangles anything else.
faq.a2: Standard Base64 uses + and /, which have special meanings in URLs, and = for padding. URL-safe Base64 replaces them with - and _ and drops the padding, so the result can be dropped into a query string or path unchanged.
faq.a3: No, and this matters. Base64 is an encoding, not a cipher — anyone can decode it instantly, as this page demonstrates. Never use it to protect passwords, tokens or personal data.
faq.q4: Why does my Base64 fail to decode?
faq.a4: Usually a stray character from copying, or missing padding. Padding is restored automatically and URL-safe characters are accepted, so what is left is normally whitespace or a truncated string.
faq.a5: No. Encoding and decoding happen entirely in your browser, so you can safely paste tokens or configuration snippets you would not want to send to a third-party site.

json-formatter.short: Format, validate and tidy JSON with clear error messages.
json-formatter.title: JSON Formatter & Validator — free online tool

json-formatter.intro: Paste JSON to format and validate it as you type. If it is invalid you get the parser's own message and the input is highlighted, so you can find the problem instead of hunting for it.

faq.a1: No. It is parsed and formatted entirely in your browser, which matters because JSON being debugged often contains API keys, tokens or customer records. Nothing is transmitted or logged.
faq.a2: It orders object keys alphabetically at every level, leaving array order untouched since that carries meaning. It is useful for comparing two API responses that contain the same data in a different order.
faq.q3: Why does my JSON say it is invalid?
faq.a3: The most common causes are a trailing comma after the last item, single quotes instead of double, or unquoted keys — all valid JavaScript but not valid JSON. The message shown is the parser's own, including the position where it gave up.
faq.a4: Formatting happens on every keystroke, so very large documents — several megabytes — may feel sluggish while typing. Pasting the whole thing at once works fine.

word-counter.name: Word counter
word-counter.short: Count words, characters, sentences and reading time.
word-counter.title: Word Counter — count words and characters online
word-counter.description: Free online word counter. Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time as you type. Works in your browser — your text is never uploaded.
word-counter.intro: Paste or type your text below and the counts update as you write. Nothing is sent anywhere — the counting happens inside your browser, so you can safely paste private or unpublished work.

howTo.step1: Paste or type your text into the box.
howTo.step2: Counts for words, characters, sentences and paragraphs update instantly.
howTo.step3: Copy your text back out, or clear the box and start again.

faq.q1: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faq.a1: No. The counter runs entirely inside your browser using JavaScript. Your text never leaves your device, is never stored, and is not visible to us or to anyone else. You can even disconnect from the internet after the page loads and it will keep working.
faq.a2: Text is split on spaces, tabs and line breaks, and each remaining chunk counts as one word. A hyphenated term such as "e-mail" counts as a single word, while "up to date" counts as three. Numbers and standalone symbols also count as words when they are separated by spaces.
faq.q3: Does it work with Cyrillic, Uzbek and other alphabets?
faq.a3: Yes. The counter is alphabet-independent, so Latin, Cyrillic and mixed-script text are all counted correctly. This matters for Uzbek and Russian text, where some older tools miscount or drop characters entirely.
faq.q4: What is the difference between the two character counts?
faq.a4: One figure includes every character you typed, spaces and line breaks included — this is usually what social networks and SMS limits measure. The other excludes whitespace, which is what many academic and publishing guidelines ask for.
faq.a5: Reading time assumes roughly 200 words per minute, which is a common average for adults reading on screen. Treat it as a rough guide: dense technical writing reads more slowly, and familiar or informal text reads faster.

fix-encoding.name: Fix broken text
fix-encoding.short: Repair text that was read with the wrong character set.
fix-encoding.title: Fix broken Cyrillic text — mojibake repair online, free
fix-encoding.description: Free online tool that repairs text turned into gibberish by the wrong character set. Recognises windows-1251, KOI8-R, CP866 and UTF-8. Runs in your browser.
fix-encoding.intro: When a file written in windows-1251 is opened as something else, Russian text arrives as ÐŸÑ€Ð¸Ð²ÐµÑ‚ or Ïðèâåò. Paste it here, or drop the file in, and it is read back the way it was written.

howTo.step2: The repaired text appears straight away, with the character set that was identified.
howTo.step3: If the guess is wrong, pick another reading from the list underneath.

faq.q1: Why does this happen at all?
faq.a1: Text is stored as numbers, and a character set says which letter each number means. When a file is written with one set and read with another, every letter comes out as the wrong one. Latin text mostly survives because the first 128 numbers agree everywhere; Cyrillic does not.
faq.q2: Which is better, pasting or uploading?
faq.a2: Uploading, when you have the file. A file still holds its original bytes, so the right character set can simply be applied — nothing is guessed and nothing is lost. Pasted text has already been decoded, so the damage has to be worked out backwards.
faq.a3: No. If the text was saved after being mangled and the wrong reading replaced characters with question marks, the original letters are gone for good. Anything that only looks wrong, rather than having been overwritten, is recoverable.
faq.q4: What if the result is still wrong?
faq.a4: Use the alternatives below the result. The tool picks whichever reading looks most like real language, but on short text several readings can look equally plausible, and you can see which one is right at a glance.

csv-to-json.title: CSV to JSON — free online converter, no upload
csv-to-json.description: Convert CSV to JSON in your browser. Detects the separator and the character set automatically, including windows-1251. Nothing is uploaded.
csv-to-json.intro: Drop in a CSV and get JSON. The separator and the character set are both worked out for you, which is what usually goes wrong with files exported from Excel in a Russian locale.

howTo.step1: Add the CSV file.
howTo.step2: Check the preview and whether the first row is a header.
howTo.step3: Copy the JSON or save it as a file.

faq.q1: My file uses semicolons. Will that work?
faq.a1: Yes. Excel in a Russian or Uzbek locale writes semicolons, because the comma is the decimal separator. The separator is detected from the file rather than assumed, and tabs and pipes work too.
faq.q2: What about Cyrillic that comes out as gibberish?
faq.a2: That means the file is windows-1251, not UTF-8. The character set is detected the same way the separator is, so those files are read correctly rather than turning into question marks.
faq.q3: Why is my phone number now a number?
faq.a3: It should not be. Values with leading zeros are deliberately kept as text, since dropping the zero from a postcode or an account number corrupts it. Turn off the typed values option to keep everything as strings.
faq.q4: What happens to duplicate column names?
faq.a4: The second one gets a suffix. Without that, one column would silently overwrite the other.

json-to-csv.name: JSON to CSV
json-to-csv.short: Flatten JSON into a spreadsheet-ready CSV.
json-to-csv.title: JSON to CSV — free online converter with nested field support
json-to-csv.description: Convert JSON to CSV in your browser. Nested objects become dotted columns and every key gets a column. Nothing is uploaded.
json-to-csv.intro: Paste an array of objects and get a CSV you can open in Excel. Nested objects are flattened into dotted column names, and a key that only appears in some records still gets its own column.

howTo.step1: Paste your JSON, or drop in a .json file.
howTo.step2: Check the preview and choose a separator.
howTo.step3: Save the CSV.

faq.q1: What happens to nested objects?
faq.a1: They become dotted columns: {'{'}"user": {'{'}"name": "Ivan"{'}'}{'}'} becomes a column called user.name. That is what spreadsheet exports do, and what most importers expect back.
faq.q2: What if my records have different keys?
faq.a2: Every key found anywhere gets a column, in the order it first appears. Records missing a key get an empty cell rather than being shifted.
faq.q3: Should I add the BOM for Excel?
faq.a3: Yes, if you are going to open it in Excel on Windows. Without it Excel reads a UTF-8 file as the local code page and Cyrillic comes out as gibberish. Leave it off for anything you are going to process with code.
faq.q4: What about arrays inside a record?
faq.a4: An array of simple values is joined with commas into one cell. Anything more complicated is written as JSON in the cell, so nothing is lost.

csv-to-excel.name: CSV to Excel
csv-to-excel.short: Turn a CSV into a real .xlsx workbook.
csv-to-excel.title: CSV to Excel — convert CSV to XLSX online, free
csv-to-excel.description: Convert CSV to a real Excel .xlsx file in your browser. Detects the separator and character set, so Cyrillic is not mangled. Nothing is uploaded.
csv-to-excel.intro: Save yourself the import wizard. This reads the CSV — working out the separator and the character set — and writes a proper .xlsx that opens with the columns already split.

howTo.step1: Add the CSV file.
howTo.step2: Check the preview to confirm the columns split correctly.
howTo.step3: Press Convert to Excel and download the workbook.

faq.q1: Why not just open the CSV in Excel?
faq.a1: Because Excel guesses, and on a Russian-locale machine it usually guesses wrong — one column of text, or Cyrillic turned into gibberish. This does the detection first and hands Excel a file with nothing left to guess.
faq.a2: Values are written as text as they appeared in the CSV, so a long account number is not rewritten in scientific notation.
faq.a3: Yes, a genuine Excel workbook, not a CSV with the extension changed. It opens in Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets.
faq.a4: No. It is read and written in your browser.

excel-to-csv.name: Excel to CSV
excel-to-csv.short: Export a sheet from an .xlsx as CSV.
excel-to-csv.title: Excel to CSV — convert XLSX to CSV online, free
excel-to-csv.description: Convert an Excel .xlsx sheet to CSV in your browser, with a choice of separator and a BOM for Excel. Nothing is uploaded.
excel-to-csv.intro: Pick a sheet from a workbook and export it as CSV, choosing the separator yourself instead of accepting whatever your locale decides.

howTo.step1: Add the .xlsx file.
howTo.step2: Choose the sheet and the separator.
howTo.step3: Save the CSV.

faq.q1: Can I export more than one sheet?
faq.a1: One at a time — CSV is a single table by definition. Pick each sheet from the list and save it separately.
faq.q2: What happens to dates and formulas?
faq.a2: You get the value as it was displayed, not the formula behind it or the serial number underneath. That is what makes the export match what you saw in Excel.
faq.a3: Comma for anything that will be read by code. Semicolon if it needs to open cleanly in Excel on a Russian or Uzbek machine.
faq.a4: Excel on Windows assumes the local code page unless a UTF-8 file starts with a byte-order mark. With Cyrillic in the file, leaving it off is the usual cause of gibberish.

excel-to-json.name: Excel to JSON
excel-to-json.short: Convert a spreadsheet sheet into JSON.
excel-to-json.title: Excel to JSON — convert XLSX to JSON online, free
excel-to-json.description: Convert an Excel sheet to JSON in your browser. Choose the sheet, use the first row as keys, and keep numbers as numbers. Nothing is uploaded.
excel-to-json.intro: Turn a sheet into an array of objects, using the header row as the keys. Useful for getting a spreadsheet someone sent you into a form your code can read.

howTo.step1: Add the .xlsx file.
howTo.step2: Choose the sheet and confirm the header row.
howTo.step3: Copy the JSON or save it as a file.

faq.q1: Which sheet is used?
faq.a1: The first one, unless you pick another from the list. Only the selected sheet is converted.
faq.a2: Yes by default, except for values with leading zeros, which stay text so that postcodes and account numbers survive. Turn the option off to keep everything as strings.
faq.a3: The value appears in the first cell of the merged range and the rest are empty, which is how the file itself stores it.
faq.a4: Completely empty rows are skipped rather than becoming objects with no values in them.

json-to-excel.description: Convert JSON into a real Excel .xlsx file in your browser. Nested objects become dotted columns. Nothing is uploaded.
json-to-excel.intro: Paste an array of objects and get an Excel file. Handy for handing API output to someone who works in spreadsheets rather than JSON.

howTo.step2: Check the preview.
howTo.step3: Press Convert to Excel and download the workbook.

faq.a2: Nested objects are flattened into dotted columns. Arrays of simple values are joined into one cell; anything deeper is written as JSON in the cell.

faq.a4: Yes, a genuine .xlsx workbook that opens in Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets.
